name: Cascade
description: Blocks dropping in a four-step stair that resets every fourth column — a falling rhythm you can count.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 6%; top: 6%; width: 88%; height: 88%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: translateY(@calc((@x % 4) * 14)%); transform: translateY(@calc((@x % 4) * 14)%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
